newsitem.title: USA: Cardiovascular gets FDA OK for P.D. Access.
newsitem.headline: Cardiovascular gets FDA OK for P.D. Access.

text.p: CardioVascular Dynamics Inc said it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to begin marketing the company's P.D. Access vascular access products in the United States.
This FDA clearance allows CVD to market three product variations of P.D. Access devices.

P.D. Access technology involves the use of a tiny Doppler Ultrasound circuit placed at the tip of a specially-designed vascular access needle or catheter. The tiny Doppler is required to locate the tiny arteries and veins of small infants, the company said.
